definitions: A pedal or lever in a vehicle used to control the speed of the engine.
An apparatus for accelerating charged particles to high velocities.
A substance that increases the speed of a chemical reaction.
An organisation or program that helps new companies develop quickly.
examples: He pressed his foot down on the accelerator.
The particle accelerator spans several miles.
Added a chemical accelerator to the mortar.
The startup joined a tech accelerator in London.
